messages:
elaine_marketing: Quick sync — launching a small experiment next week to simplify tier names on pricing + add a slimline calculator and updated FAQ snippets. Goal: reduce cognitive load on the page and route inbound leads more precisely. 

sam_growth: nice. what metrics are we optimizing? MQL conversion or demo requests?

elaine_marketing: primarily demo requests (short term) and drop in time-on-page confusion signals. baseline: demo click-through 1.8%, target 2.6%. also check funnel drop on /pricing -> /signup.

maria_product: for tier names, can we keep one technical term for eng teams + one friendly term? e.g., "Developer" / "Team" vs "Scale"? want to avoid "Pro/Enterprise" genericness.

jenna_design: I can mock variants. leaning toward two-line headings: short label + one-liner microcopy. will add microcopy for calculator tooltip.

elaine_marketing: thanks. rough copy idea: 
`Starter (dev) — pay-as-you-go for prototypes`
`Team (shared) — reserved capacity, lower unit costs`
`Scale (committed) — SLA + private deployment`

devon_ops: routing note: we'll add an inbound tag when someone uses the calculator and selects "Scale": `lead_channel=enterprise_queue`. Also webhook payload: `{"lead_type":"calculator","tier":"Scale","est_annual":...}`. I can wire that to SFDC + Intercom.

chris_sales: make sure enterprise_queue includes a priority flag so AE gets pinged. We don't want 500 low-intent leads.

elaine_marketing: agreed — plan to add a short qualifying checkbox in calc: "We're evaluating production deployments (SLA, private VPC)" which sets priority.

elly_cs: support docs need small FAQ lines: how committed capacity billing works + cancellation windows. I'll draft.

jenna_design: here's initial tooltip for calculator: 
```
Enter monthly token volume -> we show estimated monthly cost by tier. 
Note: estimates exclude data egress and optional private deployment fees.
```

sam_growth: how are we A/B testing? full page rewrite or just microcopy + calculator?

elaine_marketing: run an A/B with 50/50: control (current page) vs varA (slimline names + calc + inbound routing). We'll run 4 weeks or until 5k visitors. Primary KPI: demo CTA CTR. Secondary: time-on-page and sales-accepted leads.

maria_product: small experiment on FAQ: replace long paragraphs with Q->A bullets. Example Q: "How does dedicated capacity billing work?" A: 3 bullets: commit, bill cadence, cancellation.

devon_ops: routing playbook draft: if calculator selects Scale and checkbox = true -> create SFDC lead + set lead_score=50 + notify #sales-enterprise via webhook. Else -> route to demo-nurture flow.

chris_sales: can we add "interested in webinar" checkbox to feed webinar list? We'll push a targeted webinar for folks who hit Scale.

elaine_marketing: yes — add webinar opt-in checkbox; we’ll surface a follow-up email series focused on cost/perf tradeoffs, plus a benchmark narrative.

launch_bot: Reminder: Marketing experiment "Slimline pricing + calc" scheduled to go live 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC. CI deploy window reserved 06:00-08:00 UTC. :rocket:

jenna_design: I'll upload designs by EOD tomorrow. elaine, can you confirm copy?

elaine_marketing: will finalize copy tomorrow AM. tagging @sam_growth for tracking plan.

sam_growth: I'll add tracking: demo_click, calc_use, calc_submit, calc_tier_selected, calc_priority_checkbox. Also funnel dashboard in Looker — aim to have seg by UTM and region.

elly_cs: once live I'll prepare quick reply templates for support: 3 bullets + link to expanded docs.

maria_product: one more ask — add a short benchmark blurb under the calculator: "Typical Team: 150k tokens/mo -> ~ $X with caching + batching". keeps expectations realistic.

elaine_marketing: good call. include that in microcopy. ok team — action items: jenna mock, elaine copy, devon hook, sam tracking, elly support doc, chris webinar flow. We'll reconvene day-before-launch. :+1:
